verdict.rationale: The evidence shows usage and cost dashboards, risk-finding counts, tool logs, and an in-dashboard agent harness for testing MCP servers. None of it documents AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data inside the product. Reading observability data through an external MCP client (Claude Code, Cursor) is an adjacent capability delivered by other agents, not in-product AI insights. Conventional analytics like 'measure tool effectiveness' are not AI-generated suggestions either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
